sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 234557, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('the first of which has 21 sites with electric hookups') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234557 (notice 'Full RV hookups are not available') + RIDB catalog (bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: 10 list Electricity Hookup 50, 21 list 30; 12 list Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 127 sites in Sugar Ridge (Campground 1, 21 electric sites) and Campgrounds 2 and 3, plus walk-to, tent-only, double and group sites. 'Prime' sites have a lake view or direct lake access. Catalog lengths run 20-50 ft, most back-in. Route 603 NW of the campground is unsuitable for RVs (see note).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('There are 127 camp sites, a sandy beach, and a group picnic site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234557 (Facilities: 'Each campground has "Prime" sites which have a view and/or direct access to the lake') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length 20-50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two dump stations (Campgrounds 1 and 2), sandy beach, boat ramp at Bolar Flat Marina (concession). 2026: wastewater plant replacement - only Sugar Ridge (Campground 1) opened, first-come from May 15, with portable toilets only and the picnic pavilion closed.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234557 ('Potable water taps can be found throughout each camp along with flush toilets and showers', 'one of the two dump stations at Campground 1 or Campground 2') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('Amenities will be limited, and only portable toilets will be available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: USFS 'Seasons of Use: Memorial Day Weekend - Labor Day Holiday'. In 2026 Sugar Ridge opened May 15.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use Memorial Day Weekend - Labor Day Holiday', 'Sugar Ridge Campground (Campground 1) will open for first-come, first-served camping beginning May 15, 2026'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Normally reserved on recreation.gov, with 'Additional first-come, first-served sites'. 2026 exception: no reservations; Sugar Ridge (Campground 1) was the only loop open, first-come from May 15, during wastewater plant construction (USFS points to Morris Hill as the reservable alternative). 14 nights maximum, 14 per month.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234557 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month'; notice 'Additional first-come, first-served sites may be available') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('No reservations will be accepted for this campground during the 2026 season'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 USFS fees: standard non-electric $21, premium non-electric on the water $23, electric $30 (Campground 1); double sites $32-37, tent-only $18, walk-to $16.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('2026 Fee's for', 'Standard Non-Electric = $21', 'Electric Sites = $30', 'Premium Double Site = $37'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Senior and Access passes halve the base campsite fee, but not the electric charge, double or group sites.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups)', 'Discount passes are also not available to discount the use of Double or Group sites'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $21/$30 (2026 USFS fee table), 50A/water hookups (no sewer: 'Full RV hookups are not available'), Senior/Access discount. Added 127 sites to 50 ft, water/flush/showers/dump, season Memorial Day-Labor Day, rec.gov booking with 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max, some FCFS. 2026 partial operation (Campground 1 only, FCFS, portable toilets) recorded in booking/facilities notes.
